etsy.title: Programmer Wrapping Paper, Dark Mode Developer Gift Wrap, Coding Tech Birthday, Software Engineer Nerd
etsy.description:
Developer wrapping paper with minimalist terminal, code bracket, and angle bracket icons in a teal-on-navy tiled pattern, perfect for wrapping gifts for the programmer in your life.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• Physical wrapping paper printed on 90gsm fine art paper, shipped directly to you
• Available in three sizes: 30×36″ (single sheet), 30×72″ (roll), and 30×180″ (large roll)
• Choose matte or glossy finish
• Dark navy background (#011627) with teal developer icons (#7FDBCA) in a repeating tile pattern with a subtle glow effect

HOW TO USE
Wrap birthday, holiday, or just-because gifts for any coder, developer, or tech enthusiast. The dark mode color scheme makes every package look like it was designed in a code editor.

This listing is a physical product, not a digital download. The paper is recyclable. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Most competitor designs use binary code, circuit boards, or matrix-style patterns; minimalist icon-based designs are underrepresented.
Dark backgrounds (black, navy) are common; teal/green accents echo terminal and matrix themes.
Listings that name specific audiences (programmer, coder, software engineer) in the title appear to rank well.
Price range for physical wrapping paper rolls on Etsy runs roughly $9 to $35, with most single sheets around $7-18 and rolls around $18-27.
Amazon titles consistently use 'programmer wrapping paper' or 'coding themed gift wrap' as openers, followed by audience terms like 'developer', 'tech enthusiast', and 'nerd'.
Multi-sheet sets (12 sheets, 20x28 in) are the dominant format on Amazon, while Etsy favors rolls.
Circuit board and binary code designs dominate; minimalist icon patterns are rare.

research.notes: Primary keyword 'programmer wrapping paper' chosen because it directly targets the buyer intent and appears frequently in both Etsy and Amazon listing titles. Etsy has indexed market pages for 'coding_wrapping_paper', 'nerdy_wrapping_paper', and 'computer_code_wrapping_paper', confirming buyer search volume. Our product differentiates with a minimalist icon-based design rather than the common binary code or circuit board patterns, and the dark navy + teal color scheme stands out from the typical black + green matrix look.
